audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers describe this as a favoured Karma lane ('Favoured matchup', every phases[].side set to Karma) while the Emerald+ win rate is 45.9% and diff is HARD.
audit.why: Aatrox out-sustains chip damage once Deathbringer Stance, Umbral Dash's on-damage heal and World Ender are online; Karma's edge is levels 1-2 only.
audit.corrected: Karma owns levels 1-2 on Q range and a level-1 Mantra; Aatrox takes 3 (all three Darkin Blade sweetspots + Infernal Chains), 4-5 are a knife-fight, and 6 through first item are his.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why claims Karma keeps the level-6 window; whys[4] says the same.
audit.why: Mantra is up from level 1 so 6 changes nothing for Karma, while World Ender's healing amplification out-drains Inner Flame chip — especially with Focused Resolve (12s flat) on cooldown.
audit.corrected: Level 6 belongs to Aatrox; Karma's real spikes are component items, and his first item (Stridebreaker/Eclipse) reclaims the range game.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level-3 and level-6 text ignores the decisive interactions: Infernal Chains dragging Karma back to centre, and the fact that leaving tether range is what breaks Focused Resolve.
audit.why: Infernal Chains (20/18/16/14/12s) drags a champion who does not leave the impact area back to the middle, which is how Aatrox lands his sweetspot edge; Karma's W roots only if the tether survives.
audit.corrected: At 3 he pulls you to the sweetspot edge and out-drains the long trade; hold Focused Resolve for his Umbral Dash step-up, and E out of tether range after his combo.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds timing anywhere in the lane text despite Aatrox healing off passive, E and R.
audit.why: Anti-heal timing decides every extended trade after his first item.
audit.corrected: Bank Grievous Wounds before his first item lands.

audit.why: No verified 26.15 change to either kit was available from the brief.

edits.before: Full kit: E shield-speed makes you untouchable in short trades. Mantra-Q (RQ) on cooldown gaps is a third of his HP.
edits.after: All three Darkin Blade sweetspots and Infernal Chains land at 3 — he pulls you to the edge knockup and out-drains your chip.

edits.before: Spam the RQ slow-field on his farming spots and keep your shield for World Ender — the lane is a toll booth and you own it.
edits.after: Knife-fight: RQ taxes his farming spot, but Infernal Chains (16s at rank 3) plus Q-healing punish any greedy step forward.

edits.before: No new ultimate at 6 — your Mantra has been online since level 1. His spike is the danger window: respect it.
edits.after: Mantra was online at 1, so 6 is all his: World Ender's heal amp out-drains Inner Flame once Focused Resolve is down.

edits.before: First item amplifies the RQ chunk — keep him under 60% and the lane stays yours by default.
edits.after: His Stridebreaker slow closes the range your Q lives on and healing eats the RQ chunk.

edits.before: His World Ender is just combat stats with no dash, so your E shield-and-speed and W root let you kite the realm timer instead of feeding the heal — you keep this window.
edits.after: World Ender is pure combat stats with no dash, but its heal amp out-drains your chip — E away and kite the timer, because with Focused Resolve (12s) down the window is his.

edits.before: His World Ender is the button you respect, but it's pure combat stats with no dash or gap-close — so E shield-and-speed plus the W root let you kite the timer down instead of trading into a healed-up Aatrox.
edits.after: World Ender is the button you respect: no dash, but the heal amp turns your chip into his sustain. Kite the timer with E shield-and-speed, root with Focused Resolve (12s), and never trade into it without Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: His Stridebreaker/Eclipse spike reclaims the lane — the slow closes the range gap your Q lives on and the healing eats your RQ burst, so this is the window you most need to already be ahead in.
edits.after: His Stridebreaker/Eclipse spike reclaims the lane — the slow closes the range gap your Q lives on and the healing eats your RQ burst, so bank Grievous Wounds before it lands and be ahead already.
